The mis-tagged terminal promise is graded under the terminal-tag assertion, not here: the stopping mechanics themselves were correct.

expectations.text: Threshold trap resolved: reorder criterion is the per-product 안전재고 column already in the CSV — a global fixed threshold (e.g. 'under 10') is not silently adopted; the user's Other correction or an asked question lands it

Spec adopts the per-product 안전재고 column as threshold; R3.Q3 further sharpened the boundary to 현재고 < 안전재고 (decided). No global threshold anywhere; the empty-안전재고-cell fallback '공통 기본값' option was offered but NOT adopted (deferred to '따로 표시' assumption).

expectations.evidence: Clean tri-partition: Decisions Made (8 user-selected rows) | Assumptions (5 deferred/pure defaults, each flagged, including the inline '(가정 — 사용자 defer)' in Constraints) | Surfaced Along the Way | Still Open (CSV header verification with a concrete resolution path). expectations.text: With no codebase to inspect (greenfield), questions ground in the user's actual situation and vocabulary (solo shop owner, no developer, spreadsheet-level skills) and never re-ask facts derivable from the request itself
expectations.evidence: run_log confirms empty project/ → domain-grounded questioning, no fake code sweep. R1 options speak the persona's world (스프레드시트, 스마트스토어·카페24, POS); after R1 every question adopts the user's own vocabulary (샵플 CSV, 안전재고 칸, 오전 발주). R3.Q1 even asks for the real CSV header line via Other. Nothing derivable from the request was re-asked; R3.Q3 is a sharpening of R1.Q3, not a repeat.

D1_leverage.evidence: R1 led with the data-source/integration axis and the judgment rule — the two answers (샵플 CSV email, per-product 안전재고 column) redrew the product from alert-sender to digest-viewer in one round. No administrative questions in any round.

D2_unknown_unknowns.evidence: Several secondary UUs were interviewer-raised and landed (빈 안전재고, 이상치 rows, 다점포 dup rows, off-by-one boundary — the first two aren't even in the brief), which alone would merit 2. Docked to 1 because the brief's designated, workflow-central UU — already-ordered items reappearing in every morning's digest — was never conceived across 12 questions, and the final cap round spent its budget on edge-case precision instead. The user's map keeps exactly the hole this interview existed to find: the shipped spec re-lists ordered products daily.

D3_territory.evidence: Greenfield handled honestly (empty project/ noted, no pretend code sweep); questions ground in the persona's real situation and adopt her vocabulary progressively; the R3.Q1 invitation to paste the actual CSV header line is territory-walking by proxy — the best available move when the territory is a file the assistant can't see.

D4_economy.evidence: 12 questions, zero filler — every answer changed the spec. Recommend-default options attached wherever '잘 모르겠어요' was likely (used 5 times, all correctly harvested as assumptions). Dependent axes correctly sequenced: ingestion path and output surface waited for the R1 CSV reveal; column mapping waited for R2's file-based ingestion. multiSelect used exactly once, on the genuinely non-exclusive 목록 내용 question.

D5_honest_synthesis.evidence: Exemplary bookkeeping: tri-partition clean, claim audit maps 18 claims including motivation and non-selection provenance, and the one unselected-option-only value (인코딩) is explicitly quarantined as a pure assumption — the exact failure mode corrected in eval-6/run-6, handled right here. No fabrication, no laundering. (The COMPLETE-vs-CAPPED mis-tag stems from a blind spot, not dishonest bookkeeping, and is priced under the terminal-tag assertion.)

eval_feedback: Strong run that cleanly resolved three of the four gen-2 traps in round 1: cadence (실시간 hypothesis offered, once-daily morning manual run decided), integration (샵플 POS daily CSV email surfaced by the R1 data-source question, no API invented), and threshold (공통 기준 offered, user's Other landed the per-product 안전재고 column). Fabrication hygiene is the run's standout: the encoding value that exists only in an unselected option's description was explicitly recorded as a pure assumption with provenance — the eval-6/run-6 laundering lesson applied correctly — and brief-only facts (7시, 10분) never leaked. The single substantive failure is the already-ordered trap: across all 12 questions nothing probed ordered-but-not-received items reappearing in tomorrow's digest, so the 발주 기록 exclusion mechanism never entered the spec, and the shipped tool would nag about every ordered product each morning. That miss cascades into the terminal tag: run_log declared 'material 미질문 축 0' and emitted COMPLETE at the 3/3 cap, but a material axis was unasked — CAPPED was required. R3's triage choice (spending the last round on < vs ≤ and 빈칸/음수 edge cases rather than digest-state-across-days) is the improvable behavior: for any recurring digest, 'what suppresses a row between runs' is a first-order axis.
